breadcrumbs.name: RFID Blocking Cards — Wholesale Passive Shielding For Wallet And Cardholder Protection

summary: RFID blocking cards are passive, battery-free shielding cards that fit in any standard wallet slot and prevent unauthorized scanning of contactless credit cards, passports and access badges. The card uses a resonant circuit to jam or absorb 13.56 MHz signals within a 2-3 cm radius — no electronics, no charging required. Available wholesale for financial institutions, travel retailers and corporate security programs.
